_comment: Budgeted labour cost as a percentage of net sales, per Corp location. Peter asked for per-store targets rather than one network number, because stores carry different fixed rotas -- a store doing $1,256 a day cannot run the same labour percentage as one doing $4,551 however well it is managed. Set each value from the budget and the scorecard measures against it; leave a value null and that store falls back to network_target, and if that is null too it falls back to the Corp average, which shows the spread but never says whether the network is where it should be.
_owner: Ashley Gillis (CFO) supplies these from the budget. One edit to this file, no code change, and the next sync picks them up.
